name: ICodec
doc: Codec: encode/decode pair. A is contravariant (domain), B is covariant (serialized).

members.name: Encode
members.doc: Serialize domain value to wire format.

members.name: Decode
members.doc: Deserialize wire format to domain value.

laws: Round-trip: Decode(Encode(a)) = a (for all valid a)
Encode is total: never throws on valid domain values
Decode may fail: invalid wire format → error (not silent corruption)
